lines.zh: 我踩着沙子走，破袍子拖在后面。
lines.en: I walk the sand with my torn robe dragging.
My bones click with each step.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可沙子在我脚下变硬。
lines.en: I am slow, but the sand hardens under me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，拂开挡路的破布。
lines.en: I raise a hand and push a rag aside.
I circle the stone pillar once.
The wind lifts my long robe.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边走，沙子向后流。
lines.en: I walk your way and the sand flows backward.
My feet are bone, not flesh.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，时间慢了一点。
lines.en: Time runs a little slow where I pass.
I stop on the dune, then go on.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子走，影子很长。
lines.en: I shuffle along, my shadow very long.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，沙子从骨缝漏下去。
lines.en: I lift a foot and sand pours out of the bones.

lines.zh: 我站着，袍角没有风也动。
lines.en: I stand, and my robe stirs without wind.
My skull slowly turns.
I raise a hand and the sand lifts.
I am watching to see who still dares advance.
Time does not sit right around me.
I have no need to breathe.
The sand under me changes slowly.
I raise one finger.
I say nothing; my bones creak.
These dunes are mine.
I lower my skull to you.

lines.zh: 你比一粒沙大不了多少。
lines.en: You are not much more than a grain of sand to me.
I lifted a hand halfway.

lines.zh: 你身上的时间走得很快。
lines.en: Time runs quickly on you.
I tilt my skull.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，沙子跟上了。
lines.en: You step back, and the sand follows.
The wind does not blow on you here.
I lower my hand.
You should not have walked into this sand.
I take a step back and my bones creak.
I have written that in the sand.
I raise a hand to my ribs.

lines.zh: 破袍下露出肋骨，我停了一拍。
lines.en: My ribs show through the torn robe, and I pause a beat.
I make no sound, only look.
Time around me wavers.
I push myself up.
You can move bone, then.

lines.zh: 我抬起手骨，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise a bony hand and lower it slowly.
That was somewhat interesting.
Bones have no need to eat.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给一副骨架。
lines.en: You offer food to bones.
That is as good as nothing to me.

lines.zh: 供品落地就旧了，我不需要。
lines.en: Offerings age the moment they fall; I need none.
I turn my skull aside.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，被时间磨成了灰。
lines.en: What you hold crumbles to dust in my time.
I raise a hand and it sinks into sand.
That will not keep my feet.

lines.zh: 我的空眶朝它偏了一下。
lines.en: My empty sockets tilted toward it.
This belongs to you now.
You strike me and the sand parts first.
My feet did not move; the sand did.
I raised a bony arm to block.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我骨头上，很闷。
lines.en: That struck bone with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，脚下慢了。
lines.en: When you pull back, your feet slowed.
I did not even lift a hand.

lines.zh: 我的脚在沙里站得很死。
lines.en: My feet are set hard in the sand.
The sand has gathered around me.
I pay that no mind.
I give half a step aside.
All that is left of me is bone.
I stopped such things long ago.
I shake my skull.
The dune gave no echo.
I turn and my robe sweeps the sand.
This body will not do.
I have nothing to say to you on it.
I return to where I stood.
Time takes such things away.
I walk slowly off.
I raise a hand and it floats to my palm.
Light as a wisp of sand.
I let it fall back into the sand.
I turned it over and looked.
I squeeze it, and it ages.
There is no good in keeping this.
I returned it to your hand.
It crumbles between my fingers.
I put it in a pocket.
I will not keep this one.
I raised my skull.
You have come within reach.
I raise a hand and the sand begins to turn.
Time in this stretch answers to me.

lines.zh: 我的眼眶空了，可我看得见你。
lines.en: My sockets are empty, yet I see you.
I walk toward you, slowly.
The harder you run, the slower you go.
I raised one finger.
The dune has closed behind you.
I am not pressed for time.
Of them all, you.
The hem of my robe has gone still.
One more step changes nothing.

lines.zh: 沙子开始往一个方向转。
lines.en: The sand begins to turn one way.

lines.zh: 我抬起骨手，沙粒停在半空。
lines.en: I raise a bone hand, and sand grains hang still.

lines.zh: 我每一步都让周围的沙变慢。
lines.en: Each step of mine slows the sand around us.
You retreat, but slowly now.

lines.zh: 我周围的时间不太流动。
lines.en: Time barely moves around me.
I come down off the dune.
The sand turns around me.
You try to run, but your feet sink.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我影子里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls inside mine.
My slow pace is enough.
You turned your face this way.
Each breath draws out longer.
I raised my hand again.
The sand grows heavier.
You are going in circles; I see it.
The last stretch is short.
My bones sound under me.
You have only this one chance.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，沙浪涌起。
lines.en: My palm comes down and the sand surges.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，时间顿了一下。
lines.en: I sweep a hand and time stutters.

lines.zh: 骨架的拳头砸在你身上。
lines.en: A bony fist lands on you.
My finger bones rake across.

lines.zh: 这一下让周围慢了下来。
lines.en: That slowed everything around it.
I push sand under your feet.
You did not dodge a step.
My robe sweeps across your face.
I drew my frame upright again.
This moment draws out very long.
I do not chase; you cannot run.
I raised my finger bones.
That is the second time.
Time will keep you here.
A wind rises on the dune first.
The sand begins to flow backward.
The shadows here have lengthened.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖袍子，沙子落下来。
lines.en: I shake my robe and sand falls out.
My bones sound in the sand.
A tall shadow appears by the pillar.
The wind stopped dead here.

lines.zh: 我让你看见我，是给你机会。
lines.en: Letting you see me is a kindness.
There are very deep prints in the sand.
I raise my bony hand.
There was water here once.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方走过来。
lines.en: I have walked here from very far.
Time has knotted here.

lines.zh: 火从我的骨架间穿过去，袍子烧了起来。
lines.en: Fire passes between my bones and my robe catches.

lines.zh: 我摔进沙里，半天才爬起来。
lines.en: I fall into the sand and take a long while to rise.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的骨缝，我没有肺。
lines.en: Water fills my hollow bones; I have no lungs.
The blast tears my robe open.

lines.zh: 我身边的时间会拧起来。
lines.en: Time twists around me.

lines.zh: 一股力把我的时间拧住了。
lines.en: Some force twists the time around me.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，可我也在消散。
lines.en: I have no stomach, yet I am fading.
There is no sand and I fall.
